items.question: How many dugongs are estimated to live in Abu Dhabi's waters, giving it the world's second-largest dugong population?
items.fact: Abu Dhabi has around 3,000 dugongs, second-largest population worldwide.

items.question: How many sites in the UAE are designated as Wetlands of International Importance (Ramsar sites)?
items.fact: The UAE has 10 Ramsar wetland sites covering 39,166 hectares.
